# vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk (Resource)

Bulk management of tenant metric label values. This resource replaces all metric label values for a tenant with the provided dictionary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values_bulk" "example" {
  tenant_id = vastdata_tenant.example.id
  values = {
    environment = "production"
    region      = "us-east-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant whose metric label values are managed.
- `values` (Map of String) Dictionary of metric label keys to values. Replaces all existing values for the tenant on create and update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Terraform identifier for this resource, equal to tenant_id.
